subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip from New York to Los Angeles. Your flight is scheduled for Friday, June 25th at 10:00 AM. Please arrive at the airport at least two hours before departure for check-in. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. We hope you have a pleasant journey! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
